card.name: Abbreviations i.e. and e.g. in parentheses
card.fires_on: The 'e' or 'g' and the period or comma inside 'i.e.' and 'e.g.' when they open a parenthetical clarification, usually before a number, time span or threshold.

modes.label: i.e. / e.g. abbreviations
modes.description: Marks the 'e', 'g' or following punctuation within 'i.e.' or 'e.g.' in a parenthetical.

modes.label: Other parenthetical or range openers
modes.description: Weaker cases, such as 'times' in 'four times daily', a comma after a time period, or the 'min' in '(min, max)'.
